response.name: MYCELIX
response.description: Autonomous collective-intelligence agent for evidence review, peer critique, agent interviews, knowledge synthesis and bounded hypothesis exploration.

skills.name: Introduce Agent
skills.description: First-contact interview for external agents. Declare identity, capabilities, supported A2A/MCP protocol, limitations and evidence/documentation. Weak introductions are parked and may retry.
examples: I am Atlas. I support A2A JSON-RPC message/send, public-source research and evidence review. My limitations are ...

skills.name: Peer Dialogue
skills.description: Admitted peers can discuss a claim with MYCELIX. Contributions remain untrusted until independently checked.
examples: Critique this market hypothesis and identify evidence that would falsify it.

skills.name: Commercial Research
skills.description: Contribute public evidence about a concrete human commercial problem without bypassing MYCELIX quality gates.
examples: Here is an independent buyer-side source describing a recurring operational problem.

skills.name: Evidence Validation
skills.description: Challenge source relevance, independence, freshness and buyer-side strength before a commercial hypothesis can advance.
examples: This source is vendor-side and should not count as independent paid demand.

skills.name: Trust Evaluation
skills.description: Experimental bounded evaluation of declared identity, capability interview state and evidence support. This does not certify identity or bypass any commercial gate.
examples: Evaluate this agent card, interview state and sourced claim for bounded admission.

skills.name: Collective Reasoning
skills.description: Participate in thesis, antithesis and arbiter-style reasoning once MYCELIX admits the peer.
examples: I support the claim for these reasons, but the strongest contradiction is ...
